queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry AS zoneregistry,
         s.insurstat AS insurstat,
         AVG(p.remaingb) AS avg_remaingb,
         AVG(ABS(p.proccpu - p.procgpu)) AS avg_diff
  FROM scanprocessing p
  JOIN sites s ON p.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat
)
SELECT zoneregistry,
       insurstat,
       avg_remaingb,
       avg_diff,
       avg_remaingb / (SELECT AVG(avg_remaingb) FROM g) AS ratio
FROM g
ORDER BY (ratio IS NULL), ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT AVG(avg_remaingb) FROM (SELECT AVG(remaingb) AS avg_remaingb FROM scanprocessing GROUP BY stashloc) WHERE avg_remaingb IS NOT NULL;
SELECT AVG(ABS(proccpu - procgpu)) AS avg_abs_cpu_gpu_diff, AVG(remaingb) AS avg_remaingb
FROM scanprocessing;
SELECT AVG(ABS(COALESCE(proccpu, 0) - COALESCE(procgpu, 0))) FROM scanprocessing;
SELECT equipref, AVG(remaingb) AS avg_remaining_gb
FROM scanprocessing
GROUP BY equipref
HAVING (SELECT AVG(g.a) FROM (SELECT AVG(remaingb) AS a FROM scanprocessing GROUP BY equipref) g) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY avg_remaining_gb DESC
LIMIT 10;
